name: opencut
description: Let Claude edit your videos in the OpenCut app.
long_description: Connects Claude to the OpenCut video editor running on this computer. Claude can import your videos, cut, trim, speed up, add text, adjust volume and export, and every change appears live in the OpenCut window. OpenCut must be open for the tools to work.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: See the open project, its clips and media

tools.name: list_media_files
tools.description: Find video, audio and image files on this computer

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create and open a new project

tools.name: add_media
tools.description: Import a file into the project

tools.name: add_to_timeline
tools.description: Place imported media on the timeline

tools.name: split_clip
tools.description: Split a clip at a time

tools.name: set_speed
tools.description: Speed up or slow down a clip

tools.name: set_volume
tools.description: Change a clip's volume or mute it

tools.name: export_video
tools.description: Render the video to the Videos folder
